note: W3 (OKNA, luka 1 of W2): what the shot helper does to make two runs of the same code give the same pixels. Presets, not rules; every list is open. The server has no fixed clock for tests, so wall-clock text written by the kernel (message times, origin lines) is painted over: a line of text that matches one of `mask_text_patterns` gets a flat box over its whole element width on that line (the width of the digits never moves pixels). `mask_selectors` paint whole elements. `settle_frames`: consecutive animation frames in which every scroll position and the document height must stay the same before the shot. `fixed_time`: the time a script may pass to page.clock (installClock) when it wants the page's own Date frozen.
